content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NERAMAC Assistant General Manager – (Project Management & Capacity Building) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by North Eastern Regional Agricultural Marketing Corporation Ltd. (NERAMAC) for filling up managerial positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NERAMAC?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Assistant General Manager – (Project Management & Capacity Building) under the project management and capacity building division.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant General Manager post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NERAMAC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in, meaning eligible candidates can directly appear for the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 09 October 2026 at the designated office location in Guwahati, Assam.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the AGM post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-time MBA, PGDM, or Post Graduate degree in Project Management, Operations Management, Finance, Agribusiness, Rural Management, or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum work experience required?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have a minimum of 12 years of relevant work experience in the respective field.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 48 years as on 1st November, 2026, with age relaxations provided for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of up to Rs. 80,000/- per month on a contractual employment basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find more details and download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can check the official website www.neramac.com or use the direct important links provided in the article to view the notification.
